items.source: Expect a "Content-Type" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的"Content-Type"标头。

items.source: Expect a "Content-Type" header compatible with the given value.
items.translation: 期望与给定值兼容的"Content-Type"标头。

items.source: name - the header name
items.translation: name - 标题名称

items.source: An AssertionError is thrown if the response does not contain the specified header, or if the supplied value does not match the primary header value.
items.translation: 如果响应中不包含指定的标头，或者提供的 `value` 与主要标头值不匹配，则会抛出 AssertionError。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this to assert with diagnostics.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法以进行诊断断言。

items.source: Expect a "Cache-Control" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的“Cache-Control”标头。

items.source: Expect a "Content-Disposition" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的"Content-Disposition"标头。

items.source: Expect a "Content-Length" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的"Content-Length"标头。

items.source: Expect that the header with the given name is not present.
items.translation: 期望不存在具有给定名称的标头。

items.source: Expect that the header with the given name is present.
items.translation: 期望存在具有给定名称的标头。

items.source: Expect an "Expires" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的“Expires”响应头。

items.source: Return the exchange result.
items.translation: 返回交换结果。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this to provide access to response headers.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法以提供对响应头的访问。

items.source: Expect a "Last-Modified" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望带有给定值的“Last-Modified”标头。

items.source: Expect a "Location" header with the given value.
items.translation: 期望包含给定值的“Location”响应头。

items.source: Consume the first value of the named response header.
items.translation: 消耗命名响应标头的第一个值。

items.source: Expect a header with the given name to match the given long value.
items.translation: 期望具有给定名称的标头与给定的长值匹配。

items.source: Expect a header with the given name to match the specified values.
items.translation: 期望具有给定名称的标题与指定值匹配。

items.source: Match the first value of the response header with a regex.
items.translation: 将响应头中的第一个值与正则表达式进行匹配。

items.source: Consume all values of the named response header.
items.translation: 消耗命名响应头的所有值。

items.source:
Match all values of the response header with the given regex
patterns which are applied to the values of the header in the
same order. Note that the number of patterns must match the
number of actual values.
items.translation: 匹配响应头的所有值与给定的正则表达式模式，这些模式按顺序应用于头的值。请注意，模式的数量必须与实际值的数量相匹配。

items.source: pattern - the regex pattern
items.translation: pattern - 正则表达式模式

items.source: patterns - one or more regex patterns, one per expected value
items.translation: patterns - 一个或多个正则表达式模式，每个预期值对应一个。

items.source: consumer - the consumer to use
items.translation: consumer - 要使用的消费者

items.source: Assertions on headers of the response.
items.translation: 对响应头的断言。

items.source:
Expect a header with the given name to match the specified long value
parsed into a date using the preferred date format described in RFC 7231.
items.translation: 期望具有给定名称的标题与使用 RFC 7231 中描述的优选日期格式解析为日期的指定长值相匹配。

items.source:
Match all values of the response header with the given regex
patterns which are applied to the values of the header in the
same order.
items.translation: 匹配响应头的所有值，这些值将按顺序应用给定的正则表达式模式。

items.source: E - the type of the exchange result
items.translation: E - 交换结果的类型

items.source: R - the type of the response spec
items.translation: R - 响应规范的类型

items.source: Rob Worsnop, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rob Worsnop，Rossen Stoyanchev
